script:
आज भी यह पूरी तरह तैयार नहीं है…
सिस्टम… सक्रिय हो?
मुझे स्कूल के लिए देर नहीं होनी चाहिए।
सामान्य मोड, सक्रिय।

scenes.imagePrompt: Hand-drawn anime style. Soft, painterly background of a dreamy sky at dawn, filled with gentle pink and orange clouds. A small, stylized animated figure (the young genius) descends slowly. A softly glowing, stylized energy core shines through a device embedded in his chest area. Non-realistic proportions.
scenes.imageToVideoPrompt: Slow, gentle zoom out. The descent is smooth and silent. Ambient sound of soft wind and distant, ethereal music. NARRATION (Hindi, calm and thoughtful): 'आज भी यह पूरी तरह तैयार नहीं है…'

scenes.imagePrompt: Close-up on the character in mid-air. Four stylized, thin mechanical arms, glowing with soft blue energy, rapidly emerge from his backpack unit. They are assembling a standard school uniform (shirt, tie, jacket) around him with impossible speed and precision. His stylized boots emit a faint, stabilizing anti-gravity glow.
scenes.imageToVideoPrompt: Quick cuts showing the assembly process. Sound of rapid, precise mechanical whirs and clicks. CHARACTER (Hindi, calm): 'सिस्टम… सक्रिय हो? मुझे स्कूल के लिए देर नहीं होनी चाहिए।'

scenes.imagePrompt: Wide shot. The character, now fully dressed in his school uniform, flies smoothly and silently just above the stylized, painterly rooftops of the town. The town architecture is whimsical and non-realistic. Background characters (early risers) are blurry, unfocused shapes, completely unaware of the flying figure.
scenes.imageToVideoPrompt: Smooth tracking shot following the character's flight path. Muted, stylized city sounds below. Gentle, low hum of the flight system.

scenes.imagePrompt: The character lands silently on a patch of stylized grass near the entrance of a large, non-realistic school building. The glow from the boots and chest core instantly vanishes. The mechanical arms retract seamlessly and instantly into the backpack/uniform structure.
scenes.imageToVideoPrompt: Quick, subtle 'shhhk' sound of retraction and deactivation. The character whispers (Hindi, internal thought): 'सामान्य मोड, सक्रिय।'

scenes.imagePrompt: The character walks confidently into the schoolyard, blending in perfectly with other stylized students. The scene is bright and normal. Close-up on the character's chest, now covered by the uniform shirt. A tiny, stylized red warning symbol (like a broken circuit icon) flickers briefly on the hidden chest device, visible only to the audience, before vanishing completely.
scenes.imageToVideoPrompt: Normal schoolyard chatter and ambient sounds. A final, very subtle electronic 'bzzzt' sound accompanies the warning symbol flicker. Hold on the character walking away, looking completely normal.
